derivation: Exact original case fields and ranges, deduplicated by canonical range-array SHA256; fixture probes summarized with full-probe canonical digests. The original_manifest is immutable corpus history; execution_manifest is the distinct production5.1.9 protocol. Tools below are the final execution tools, not a claim that fixtures were regenerated.
fixture_probe_origin: Fixture generation commands and summarized probes retain their original master-build provenance. All final outputs are freshly probed/decoded with production5.1.9 tools; no original output fingerprint is reused.
limitations: No public-platform/network SLA or competitor speed claim.
HLS uses a fixed HTTPS test transport, not production network bypass.
Sampled tree RSS can double-count shared pages and miss transient peaks.
wait4 max RSS is the largest waited process peak, not simultaneous tree RSS.
Sampled process I/O totals are lower bounds; wait4 block counters are counts, not bytes.
Warm HLS operation time excludes prefill; outer CPU/RSS/I/O include prefill.

pair_protocol.cache: warm OS cache, fresh operation workspace/owner; no cache dropping
pair_protocol.ordering: AB, BA, AB, BA, AB; fixed manifest scenario order
pair_protocol.timing: single owned workload; no overlapping tests/builds/media tasks
